correctness.rationale: The conditional rank-two projection-DPP law gives an exact omission probability c_l^2 times the sum of the two relevant first-stage leverage ratios. This yields the exact staged oblique factor 2 sum r_i; a one-parameter orthogonal frame drives it to 4. A Schur-complement calculation gives the true orthogonal-CSS error, which converges to the same factor as the tail singular value tends to zero. Exact rational verification confirms a finite full-rank witness.

originality.rationale: One-shot ARP/volume-sampling bounds and conditional-DPP identities are prior results and are not claimed as new. The current Grigori--Xue preprint proves conditional tightness for a prescribed initial subset but does not state sharpness of the complete two-stage MSARP law. No located source states the exact omission law, sharp factor 4 for the joint two-stage sampler, or persistence of that sharpness for optimal orthogonal CSS projection. Originality is asserted only to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The result determines that the first nontrivial product penalty in the new incremental ARP theory is intrinsic in the stated worst-case model, rather than merely a loose oblique-projector analysis, and gives an asymptotic 4/3 separation from one-shot ARP on the same matrix family.
